synthesis.body: A blocked decision looked like it required reversing a rejected architectural option. Once the owner accepted a weaker requirement — individually acceptable installs instead of one-shot bundling — the conflicting mechanism was no longer needed at all, and the supersession collapsed from reversing that rejection to a single clause, with the rest of the prior decision explicitly standing. Draft the supersession scope last, against the narrowed requirement, not against the original ask.

title: Re-test whether a supersession is still needed after the decision owner narrows scope
